title: The CLI has no non-interactive login; CI must reuse a copied session
claim: The CLI Accounts page says evenhub login needs an interactive terminal, even with --json. For CI it says to log in on a workstation, store credentials.yaml as a secret and restore it in the job. The cli-reference skill says there is no non-interactive login.
actual: A CI job or a cloud agent cannot sign in on its own. It can upload only with a copy of a developer's credentials.yaml, which carries the whole account session, including commands such as rm and delist. When the stored refresh token expires or is revoked, a person must log in again and replace the secret; evenhub logout in any job revokes it. The docs do not say whether a refresh replaces the refresh token. evenhub pack needs no credentials, so packaging works in CI.
impact: Unattended pipelines and sandboxed agents need a human login on a workstation before they can upload, and authenticated commands exit 2 once the stored session has expired.
workaround: Store credentials.yaml as a CI secret under a job-owned XDG_CONFIG_HOME, delete the local copy after the job, and never run evenhub logout in CI.

evidence.note: Feature request from a developer who uploads from sandboxed agent sessions; asks for scoped tokens or device-code login.
